videos.desc: On a sunny quay a small group of people stand at the railing waving both arms at a white passenger ferry. An older woman in a flowered headscarf and a young man grin at the camera with their hands raised; others beside them swing pink scarves overhead. The ferry pulls away from the ramp, passengers crowded on its decks waving back, and it shrinks into the blue water towards the city skyline as the group on the quay keeps waving.

An evening birthday dinner in a room with deep blue walls and a star-shaped pierced metal lamp. Two young women sit at a wooden table laid with an embroidered cloth, a cake with lit candles, marigolds, a wrapped present and glasses of pink drink; one rests her chin on her hands and both look bored and let down. At the third place, where a guest should be, a black cat sits with its head at the plate. The woman in lilac reaches over and pats her friend's arm. Open doors show a courtyard with a fountain.

A beach at sunset under pink clouds. A young man in a white linen shirt and cream trousers kneels barefoot on a patterned picnic blanket and holds up a small open ring box. A young woman with long black hair in a flowing white dress grips his other hand and laughs with joy. He jumps to his feet, still holding the ring box, and they throw their arms around each other in a long hug. A wicker picnic basket sits on the blanket, footprints cover the sand and a man with a fishing rod walks along the waves.

On a rooftop terrace above a city at sunset, under string lights, a young woman with long dark hair in a green satin dress raises her left hand high to show off an engagement ring and laughs. Her friend in a yellow dress claps, then throws her arms around her and cheers. A young man in a light blue shirt and cream trousers punches both fists into the air and jumps with joy. On a small wooden table stand glasses of lemonade and a vase of red roses, with folding chairs and city buildings around them.

In an old cafe with an arched doorway, patterned floor tiles, carved wooden panels, a hanging lantern and a ceiling fan, a smiling young man in a rust shirt and cream trousers stands in the middle with a grey parrot with a red tail on his shoulder. Seated men holding small glasses of mint tea laugh and point at him. The parrot spreads its wings, and the young man bends his head down, laughing. A marble table with a glass of mint tea stands in front.

On a stone farmhouse terrace at sunset, a young woman in a pink wrap top and a cream midi skirt carefully carries a tall three-tier white cake decorated with pink roses on both hands, lifting one foot as a shaggy brown and white dog crouches playfully at her feet. She puts her foot down and stands still, smiling, while the dog sits and looks up at the cake. Behind her two young women in blue and lilac slip dresses dance under a vine pergola hung with string lights.

In a small comedy club lit by a spotlight, a comedian bends forward on the stage near a microphone stand. In the audience a young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt stands up from his table, cups one hand at his mouth to shout and raises his other hand with the thumb pointing down, while a man behind him holds up two thumbs down. A paper plane flies through the beam of light and falls to the floor. A waitress walks between small wooden tables with beers on them.

On the sunny wooden deck of a sailing yacht, a young man in a navy linen shirt and white trousers sits on a folding wooden chair, tied to it with many loops of pink ribbon around his chest and arms, and laughs. A young woman in a yellow sundress ties a big pink bow on top of his head, while a young woman in a red swimsuit and white shirt pulls more ribbon tight around him. Rolls of pink ribbon lie on the deck, with the mast, steel rails and blue sea behind.

In a dim, old-style bar during an evening of short dates, a young woman with curly hair in a green satin blouse and black skirt laughs with her chin on her hand, talking to a young man in a dark blazer and white shirt. He laughs, takes off his blazer and leans back, throwing his head back. On their small marble table an hourglass runs, its sand almost gone. Behind them other couples sit at small round tables lit by green banker's lamps. Two glasses of lemonade stand in the foreground.

On the front porch of a red wooden house at night, under a dark sky with a crescent moon, a young woman with long dark wavy hair, in a rust-coloured zip jacket and black cycling shorts, stands in the open white doorway and talks, then raises a fist. A young man with a beard, in a green knitted jumper, stands on the wooden deck beside a bicycle with a wicker basket and looks at her. A small brown and white dog walks out between them. A lantern glows on the wall and a pot of pink flowers sits by the step.

At a packed outdoor music festival on a hot sunny day, a young man in sunglasses, a patterned shirt and white shorts sits in a deck chair balanced on top of a tall stepladder under a big red and white striped umbrella. He cools himself with a small fan and sips a drink, while the crowd in hats and bandanas behind and below him stare up in annoyance. Security staff in black T-shirts push through the crowd, and water sprays over the field.

At a wedding party in a wooden barn lit by strings of warm fairy lights, a young man in a grey suit and dark red tie sits alone at a round table with a white cloth, confetti and plates of cake. He happily eats cake with a fork, raises one hand in a small wave, and goes back to his cake. The chairs around him are empty, with jackets and a handbag left on them. Behind him the dance floor is full of couples dancing close together.

At a wedding party in a muddy field under a grey sky, a young woman in a white chef's jacket, a stained apron and green rubber boots carries a tall four-tier white wedding cake high above her head on a board, stepping carefully through deep mud. A herd of black and brown cows crowds around her, one stretching its nose towards her. An overturned shopping trolley lies in the mud, and guests in suits and dresses watch from a wooden platform in front of a white marquee with bunting.

On a sunny city canal with red-brick warehouses and an arched bridge, a young man with curly hair in striped pyjamas and a grey cardigan stands on the back of a green narrowboat, frying eggs in a pan on a small blue camping stove. Young people climb and jump from a red narrowboat onto his boat with sunflowers, a guitar and a potted lemon tree, and a small white dog comes too. A crowd cheers on the red boat while a smiling woman with sunflowers stands next to him and he stares blankly.

An old railway platform at night. A young man in a camel coat lifts a young woman in a red coat and black boots off the ground as she throws her arms around him, then sets her down and they hug, smiling with their foreheads touching. A steam train with maroon carriages stands beside them in clouds of steam. At their feet lie a dropped leather suitcase with clothes spilling out and a knocked-over metal bucket of flowers. An old man in a suit and smiling travellers watch under the lamps and the platform clock.

Inside an airport terminal at night during a snowstorm. A tearful young woman in a camel coat jumps into the arms of a young man in a snow-covered green parka and knit hat, who holds a bunch of red roses behind her back, and they hug tightly, laughing. Around them stranded travellers sit on the floor wrapped in sleeping bags and silver foil blankets, clapping and smiling. A suitcase stands nearby, and through the tall glass windows a snowplough with orange lights works in the falling snow.

On a street of brick terraced houses in autumn, two movers in dark workwear stand by a shiny black grand piano on a metal ramp from a white van, outside a small community library with a blue door. A young man in a navy jumper hands a key to a smiling red-haired young woman, and the two talk while neighbours on the pavement clap. One mover pulls the padded blanket off the piano. Fallen leaves and lifting straps lie on the ground.

Inside a dim city pub in daylight, a tired, unshaven man in a dark jacket sits alone at the wooden bar, drinks from a glass of whisky and puts it down. He touches the row of empty shot glasses in front of him and then rests his head in his hand. A half-empty bottle, a bowl of peanuts, coins and notes lie on the bar. A young barmaid in a black apron dries a glass and watches him with concern, and people with coffee cups stand in the bright street outside the big window.

On a sunny day, a young man in a tuxedo and bow tie walks carefully down a long outdoor stone staircase between old houses, holding a tall three-tier white wedding cake on a silver tray high above his head while rose petals fall around him. Step by step he comes closer. Wedding guests cheer from a balcony at the top, a woman leans on a side balcony with a cloth hanging over the railing, and older neighbours sit on chairs by the steps next to pots of red geraniums.

A young woman with long messy black hair, a sparkly black top and a paper party hat stands on a leather sofa in a small karaoke room with coloured disco lights on the walls. With her eyes shut she sings loudly into a microphone and throws out one arm, then drops down onto the sofa, still singing and laughing. Two young women beside her laugh and cover their ears, one holding her leg. On the low table lie a half-empty beer bottle, several glasses, one knocked over, spilled crisps and a tambourine, and a TV screen glows on the wall.

On the bottom of a swimming pool, a young man with spiky black hair, in a black tuxedo and bow tie, sits at a table laid with a white cloth and pinches his nose shut, keeping his mouth closed, with his eyes wide. Around the table other young people in evening dresses and suits sit underwater, laughing, chatting and raising glasses as bubbles rise from them. Tall white candles stand on the table, a bowl of apples floats upwards and lane ropes stretch across the surface above.

On a rainy city street at dusk, in front of a bakery window full of bread, a laughing young man in a white T-shirt, soaked with rain, holds his black jacket up over his head and over a smiling young woman in a camel coat to keep her dry. She holds a paper bakery bag and touches her wet hair, and the two walk along the shop front together under the striped awning, laughing. Behind them a red telephone box, people with umbrellas, a parked bicycle and street lamps line the wet pavement.

At a summer village fête in a meadow near an old stone church tower, with bunting strung overhead, an older woman places a crown of white daisies and blue cornflowers on the long fair hair of a young woman in a navy dress standing at a wooden table covered in wildflowers and folded floral cloths. Then the young woman turns and walks away towards three other young women in flowery summer dresses, who sit holding their own flower crowns, while the older woman picks up more flowers. Villagers stand in the warm sun.

Inside a wooden barn at night, lit by old oil lanterns. A young man in a checked shirt, grey vest, braces and rolled trousers stands barefoot in front of the open barn door with his arms spread wide, telling a story. He leans forward with a wild face and then jumps up with both hands high in the air. A group of young friends sit on hay bales around him with mugs and plates, staring at him with open mouths, and a shaggy grey dog sits at his feet.

In an entrance hall with dark green walls and a patterned tiled floor, a young woman in a lilac bathrobe, a towel wrapped around her head and black high heels stands in front of the closed front door. The door swings open, and three smartly dressed young people stand on the step holding sunflowers, a cake and a wrapped present. A black and white dog runs in ahead of them. The woman jumps back in surprise, laughing, with a hand on her head, and autumn leaves blow in.

A narrow town street on a hot summer day during a water fight. On a balcony a young man and a young woman tip wooden barrels over the railing, and a huge flood of water pours from them onto a young woman in a white top and turquoise shorts standing below with her arms spread wide, laughing. She turns around under the water and then faces forward again as it splashes all over the cobbles. Colourful paper lanterns hang across the street and young people with water pistols watch.

A narrow old cobbled street at night, lit by a wall lantern. A young man in a white shirt stands below a balcony, singing with his head tilted up as he plays an acoustic guitar with everything he has, then drops to his knees on the cobbles and keeps playing. Red roses lie scattered around his open guitar case. Up on the iron balcony a young woman stands in the arms of another young man, both looking down at him. Flower pots sit by the pastel house doors.

An apple orchard at dusk under a purple evening sky. A young woman in a cream jumper and green skirt stands on a wooden stepladder, hanging a string of round light bulbs on a branch, while a young man in a blue shirt below holds up the rest of the glowing string and smiles up at her. A long table is already laid with a white cloth, a glass jug and glasses, with benches on both sides, but no guests have arrived yet. Crates of plants stand ready in the grass.

An opening night in an art gallery with white brick walls, spotlights and a big blue and orange painting. A young man in a grey suit and mustard scarf has just met a young woman in a cream coat, red beret and checked skirt; he leans in eagerly with his arms open, but she laughs and holds him back at arm's length with one hand on his chest. Behind them a young woman in a red top covers her eyes in embarrassment, and other guests stand around.

A rooftop dinner at dusk. Five young friends sit around a long table with a red and white checked tablecloth, and each of them pulls a slice from one big pizza on a wooden board, long strings of melted cheese stretching between the slices, then they bite into their pieces. A young woman in a white T-shirt and blue skirt laughs as she eats. There are glasses and a jug of lemonade, a pot of basil, lemon trees in planters, string lights overhead and a mountain on the horizon.

A cosy wooden cabin living room on a snowy night. A young man in a rust-coloured sweater wears a black sleep mask over his eyes and kneels on a white shaggy rug, feeling the face of a big fluffy white dog with both hands and talking, trying to work out what it is, while the dog licks its lips. A young woman in a pink sweater holds the dog and laughs, and another young woman in a green sweater laughs so hard on the sofa that she covers her face. A wood stove burns, with board games and mugs on the table.

A limbo game on a sandy beach at dusk. A young man in an open light blue shirt, white T-shirt and navy shorts bends his knees deeply and leans far back to get under a thin bamboo pole between two tall wooden posts, his arms stretched out. A young woman in a green top kneels by one post and watches. Friends in swimwear behind him cheer with their arms in the air, and a young woman in a purple top jumps up and shouts. A thatched beach bar with string lights stands behind under a pink and blue sky.

A wide selfie at a summer music festival at sunset. A laughing young woman in a straw hat, yellow halter top and denim shorts and a young man in an open orange shirt pose close to the camera, then step back and jump, both doing the same dance move with arms stretched out to the side and one knee lifted. Behind them hundreds of young people on the grass all copy the same move, and a man in a green cap dances into the front. A big white festival tent, bunting and a hot-air balloon fill the background.

An elegant evening event in a modern art gallery with a glass roof and large colourful abstract paintings, seen from above. Guests in black suits and long evening gowns in green, red, silver and blue stand in a group, and a string quartet plays in the corner. A man in a big inflatable green dinosaur costume walks in through the open door, waddles across the floor and crouches down while the guests turn to stare. A waiter stands by the door, and white flowers decorate the tables.

An elegant dinner in a room with gold mirrors, candelabras and a chandelier. A young woman with long braids in a blue satin dress sits at the long white table and smiles towards the others, while low beside the tablecloth, where nobody can see, she holds out a fork with a piece of roast meat to a big grey dog, which licks it. Then she lifts the fork back and sits up straight. The other guests clap, a woman in a green dress waves, and a waiter in a white jacket stands behind.

A wedding party in a wooden barn strung with fairy lights. A young man in a light grey suit leaps high above the dance floor again and again, legs split out straight to each side, arms flung up, mouth wide open and tie flying, then lands and lunges forward with a shout. A pair of shoes lies on the floor. Beside him a couple embraces, a young woman in a lilac dress covers her mouth, the bride in white claps above her head and a man in green bends over laughing. A band plays behind.
